Q&A

Hi, Kathleen! I checked your account and see that you successfully created an Icon membership for Armida Trujillo earlier today. If you need any further assistance, please feel free to contact us at concierge@curateur.com, or chat with us live between 10am - 4pm PST.
Haven't received my latest shipment.
Hi! Fall curations start shipping today - expect to receive tracking for your box this week!
How do I choose my items for the Fall 2023 box?
Hi, Holly! The selection period for Fall 2023 ended on September 4. If you're not happy with your selections, please contact us at concierge@curateur.com - we might be able to edit your order!
How is the sarong tied for the three different looks? Is it tied around the neck? I don't see any knots?
